Title: Log4Shell RCE on public edge
Description: Unauthenticated remote code execution reachable from the internet; full host compromise via exploit.
Consequence: Attacker gains SYSTEM on the internet-facing edge host with no credentials.

Title: Excessive any-any firewall rule DMZ to Corporate
Description: Flat trust any-any firewall rule lets the DMZ reach the corporate segment bypassing segmentation.
Consequence: Lateral movement from the DMZ into the corporate VLAN.

Title: Insecure deserialization RCE on app server
Description: Remote code execution on the application server via an unsafe deserialization endpoint.
Consequence: Foothold with code execution on the corporate application tier.
